canvas.static_gbuffer: 2160x3840 (2x supersampled), 49 key-light + 64 ambient samples per pixel

background.note: blue-gray cyclorama, brighter toward the top right

key_light.direction: 0.62 x camera-right + 0.30 x toward-camera + 1.05 up (normalized): soft shadows down and to the left

studio.fog: starts 160-200 units from the camera, 120 units to full

marble.look: glossy plastic: albedo + soft key highlight (Blinn-Phong 420 and 36) + sky reflection, Fresnel F0 0.05
marble.shadows: analytic soft shadows from the 11 deg light disc, contact AO within 3 radii, fade by 10 radii
marble.glow_spill: a lit tile/segment tints the marble side facing it (falls off over ~1.2 radii)

glow.halo: gaussian 16 px x 0.75 + 5 px x 0.35, x 0.95

round_title.pop: scale 0.70 -> 1.12 -> 1.00 over 0.27 s, fades in over 0.08 s

watermark.text: Marble Pop (uploads before the rename: Fun House 67)

voices.knock: marble clacks: ball 2.6-3.6 kHz, floor 620-820 Hz, wall 1.0-1.3 kHz

audio.master: 2.4 s stereo reverb 34% wet, 35 Hz high-pass, peak 0.89, tanh 1.15 soft clip, 0.6 s fade-out
audio.loudness: muxed at -13.0 LUFS integrated, AAC 192 kb/s

encode.video: H.264 libx264 veryfast CRF 17, yuv420p, GOP 60, faststart
